name: CSV Column Splitter
summary: Split one CSV column by a separator into new columns — or explode into extra rows.
description: Paste CSV, pick a column, and split cell values on a delimiter (|, ;, comma, etc.). Expand into part columns or explode one row per part. Optionally keep the original column and cap max parts. Runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: What is New columns vs Explode rows?
faqs.answer: New columns adds tags_1, tags_2, … on the same row. Explode rows duplicates the row once per part with the split column replaced.

faqs.question: What does Keep original do?
faqs.answer: In column mode it keeps the unsplit column beside the new parts. In row mode it adds a `{column}_original` field with the full value.

faqs.question: Is my CSV uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Splitting runs entirely in your browser.
